course_name: 電子材料與元件技術特論
outline:
This course enables the students know the fundamental concepts in materials science, semiconductor physics/Devices, and modern theory of solids. The introduction of electronic devices and semiconductor processing used in the current semiconductor industry are also included.
(Course taught in English)
schedule:
1. Introduction
2. Elementary Materials Science Concepts
3. Electrical and Thermal Conduction in Solids
4. Elementary Quantum Physics
5. Fundamentals of Semiconductor
6. Semiconductor Devices
7. Materials processing and fabrication
